scripts.dev: cd frontend && npm run dev & npm run server:dev
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && tsc --project server/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd .. && tsc --project server/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json && cd .. && tsc --project server/tsconfig.json
